title: softsync Local File Sync Profile v1
summary: A single-machine file protocol for prepared clients that report readiness, receive a start signal, heartbeat while active, and observe stop or cancel signals.

integration_points.name: sync_session
integration_points.description: session.json identifies the sync folder, producer, lifecycle state, and prepared start/readiness configuration.

integration_points.name: runtime_messages
integration_points.description: waiting_for_clients.json, start.json, stop.json, cancel.json, and client report files carry UC portable fields and local softsync schemas.

integration_points.name: validation
integration_points.description: softsync validate emits a machine-readable test_run result for packaged descriptors or one sync folder.

checks: Runtime messages include UC portable identity, producer, contract, timestamp, and lifecycle fields.
Terminal folders do not retain start, ready, or active files.
Local message schemas are packaged with the distribution.
The validate command reports machine-readable pass/fail status.

agent_guidance: Preserve existing softsync.*.v1 fields for compatibility and add UC fields additively.
Treat session.json as the manifest-like object for a sync folder.
Use softsync validate before claiming UC conformance for a sync folder.
